days.title: Peaks and Overthrust Landmarks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Piz Sardona
stops.detail: The seldom line along the rock face around the Piz Sardona marks the Glarus overthrust - a phenomenon of world interest.

stops.name: Murgsee lake
stops.detail: Few places illustrate the history of the Alps as impressively as the UNESCO World Heritage Site between the Murgsee lake, Pizol and Martin's Hole near Elm.
